findings.body: `forge init` copies the entire skeleton even when `pyproject.toml` or `go.mod` selects a different stack (`src/forge/init.py:35-39,77-89`). Such a client now receives this Dockerfile, whose `npm ci` and workspace builds fail without a Node app. The stack convention says clients already using another stack keep it (`stack.md:3-5`). Include this Dockerfile only for fixed-stack clients.
findings.title: Do not scaffold the Node Dockerfile into Python or Go clients
